documents.title: Quick Reference
documents.description: Evidence-based thresholds, defaults, and specifications for human-centered design — the numbers you need daily.

rules.description: Text must have sufficient contrast ratio
rules.check: Color contrast ratio must be at least 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text (WCAG AA)

rules.description: Form inputs must have associated labels
rules.check: Every input must have a visible label linked via for/id or aria-label

rules.description: Interactive elements must have visible focus indicators
rules.check: Keyboard focus must be clearly visible (recommend 3px outline)

rules.description: Long forms should use progressive disclosure
rules.check: Forms with 6+ fields should be broken into steps

rules.description: Error messages must be specific and actionable
rules.check: Avoid vague errors like "Invalid" - explain what went wrong and how to fix

rules.description: Touch targets must meet minimum size
rules.check: Interactive elements must be at least 44x44pt (iOS) or 48x48dp (Android)
Use autocomplete attributes for name, email, address, phone, etc.
Placeholder text is not a substitute for labels - labels must remain visible
Forms with multiple fields should save drafts to prevent data loss
Delete, remove, and other destructive actions need confirmation dialogs

cognitive_load.recommendation: Use progressive disclosure - break into 2-3 steps

requirements: Form works without JavaScript for critical paths

cognitive_load.assessment: Modals interrupt flow and increase cognitive load
cognitive_load.recommendation: Use sparingly, only for critical decisions or confirmations
